sources.title: Troubleshooting - Ollama
sources.snippet: Ollama includes multiple LLM libraries compiled for different GPUs and CPU vector features. Ollama tries to pick the best one based on the capabilities of your system. sources.title: Ollama Pull Failed: Fix Connection Refused & Digest Mismatch Errors
sources.snippet: digest mismatch means a corrupted local model entry. Run ollama rm <model> then ollama pull <model> again — this is the officially supported fix, safer than hand-editing the manifests folder. Ollama binds to 127.0.0.1:11434 by default. A port conflict (another process already using 11434) will also produce connection errors.
